name: Houserules
body:
Damage Reduction

DR x/magic is not completely negated by a simple magic weapon. Instead each +1 enhancement bonus negates 5 points of damage reduction.

Crafting

See Alternate Crafting Rules.

Leveling

On each gained level (after the first) the heroes receive 3/4 of their hit die as hp. A Fighter for example receives an alternating 7 or 8 hp each level.
